title: MEIDNet: Multimodal Equivariant Inverse Design Network (software, pretrained Perov-5 models and the MEIDNet Prism platform)
description:
MEIDNet designs crystalline materials from target properties. It learns one latent space shared by crystal structures and their properties, enumerates a prototype-family design space checked by chemistry rules, and searches the latent space for candidates. The release contains the Python package (CLI and API), the three pretrained Perov-5 checkpoints, the family files, the documentation and MEIDNet Prism, the interactive platform (live workbench, datasets, benchmarks).

Paper: A. Babu, R. A. Gouvêa, P. Vandergheynst, G.-M. Rignanese, npj Computational Materials (2026), doi:10.1038/s41524-026-02153-3.
